response.rationale: The item is defective (defective=True) and not final sale (final_sale=False), satisfying RET-020's condition. RET-020 has priority 90, which dominates the standard out-of-window rule RET-008 (priority 10) that would otherwise apply since days_since_delivery=41 > 30. No higher-priority rule applies: final_sale is False (RET-012 inapplicable) and fraud_hold is False. Therefore the defective item is eligible for return regardless of the standard window.
